summary: Careful, well-archived preregistered paired study that measured the marginal verifier+single-repair effect under explicit shared_initial_candidate semantics (N=250 pairs, gpt-5-mini). Results: baseline 249/250 pass, guarded 250/250 pass; contingency n11=249,n10=1,n01=0,n00=0; paired diff = +0.4 pp, 95% CI [0.0,1.2 pp], exact McNemar p = 1.0. Execution and analysis artifacts appear complete and internally consistent. Several prior required editorial/disclosure issues remain unresolved and must be fixed before finalisation.
critical_issues: Disclosure Statement in the manuscript still duplicates low-level execution bookkeeping (per-file paths and many full artifact hashes) and exceeds the concise disclosure guidance required by the track; this must be condensed in-text and replaced by a single manifest pointer into the archived evidence bundle.

The Abstract does not prominently state the preregistered sim-to-real/production-like confirmatory contrast was not executed; that important deviation must appear in the Abstract (not only in Conclusions/Disclosure) so readers immediately see the confirmatory scope.

References/citation formatting is not verifiably presented as a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography in the supplied manuscript text. The paper must present a standard IEEE numbered References section (authors, title, venue, year, DOI/URL when available) and ensure each in-text numeric citation [n] correctly corresponds to and is supported by the listed record.
required_revisions: Condense the Disclosure Statement in the main manuscript: remove per-file paths and per-artifact full hashes from the paper body, provide one concise manifest pointer (single short SHA-256 or archive locator) that references the archived evidence bundle, and move file-level bookkeeping into that archived bundle.

Add a clear, explicit sentence to the Abstract stating that the preregistered sim-to-real/production-like confirmatory contrast was not executed and that the reported confirmatory estimand/inference applies only to the synthetic/emulation partition run.

Ensure the References section is a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography (authors, title, venue, year, DOI/URL where available); replace any identifier-only entries with full bibliographic entries and verify that every in-text numeric citation corresponds to the correct IEEE reference and supports the proximate claim.
optional_revisions: Shorten and focus Related Work to the most closely adjacent papers (e.g., Verified Prompt Programming, Batfish evolution, NetConfEval) and explicitly compare how the shared_initial_candidate paired design differs from prior GVR evaluations.

Include a succinct mapping (one short paragraph or small diagram) that links adapter/provider audit labels (e.g., condition_counts/stage_counts entries) to pipeline stages (initial generation, validator check, repair) to aid reader comprehension.

Add a one-line explicit callout in Limitations noting that the realized baseline pass-rate (0.996) departed from the preregistered power assumption (~0.90), reducing power to detect small absolute improvements.
